conclusions.finding: The five stages cover same-App cleanup retention followed by actual Reader process exit and forced reclamation; they do not cover reader/back release within the same process.
five_stages: lease-provider--fixture-seed: actual application initializes isolated data; only public loopback source inputs are configured

conclusions.limits: No concurrent independent GUI-process retention, continuous physical-display observation, or same-process reader/back reclamation claim. Standalone captures have zero visual-round credit. The existing CacheLease unit-test evidence scope is unchanged.
